title: Data Scientist, Product Analytics
text:
Fernway Travel helps 10 million travelers plan trips. Our analytics team is hiring a Data Scientist focused on product analytics.

What you'll do
- Design and analyze A/B tests for search and booking features.
- Build forecasting and time series models for demand; build recommendation systems features with our ML team.
- Write production-quality SQL in BigQuery and Python (Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn).
- Create dashboards in Looker and communicate insights through data visualization.
- Partner with engineering on feature engineering and experiment tooling in Jupyter.

Qualifications
- MS in Statistics, Economics, Computer Science or a related field.
- 2+ years of experience in data analysis and statistical modeling.
- Experience with R or Python; XGBoost or LightGBM a plus.
- Strong communication skills and stakeholder management.
